Is this support reply good enough to send? It is good enough when it answers in plain words and invents nothing.

Thank you for reaching out with your questions regarding the export functionality. I have reviewed our documentation and, unfortunately, we do not currently have information specifying whether the application supports multiple simultaneous filters during an export, nor are there listed constraints or limitations regarding export behavior when filters are active. I apologize for the lack of clarity on this topic and would be happy to escalate this to our technical team for further investigation.
